P01.rationale: The founder (Martina Ammon) is named and her portrait appears in a dedicated section on the right, but she is not the dominant visual anchor of the page as the large '01' numeral and dark panel dominate the composition.

P05.rationale: The client portrait (Martina Ammon) is present within the dark blue sidebar at a meaningful size, though it is somewhat obscured by the heavy background color rather than being clearly framed against white space.

P07.rationale: There are no press logos or review grids; instead, there is a single testimonial quote block at the bottom of the sidebar which serves as weak social proof.

P10.rationale: A massive, oversized '01' numeral acts as a dominant decorative typographic element that anchors the entire right-hand column.

P11.rationale: The page contains specific data visualizations (e.g., '24 Std. -> Minuten', '> 200.000 €'), but they are presented as simple text comparisons rather than graphical charts or before/after visuals.

P12.rationale: The layout is dense and magazine-quality, utilizing a two-column structure that fills the sheet with text blocks, headers, and data points without large gaps.

P13.rationale: While there is a background texture (paper grain), the dominant visual element is a flat, solid dark blue color block which feels more like a digital overlay than an atmospheric texture.

P14.rationale: The large '01' numeral sits directly on top of the dark blue panel without any scrim or darkening treatment to ensure text readability underneath it.

P16.rationale: A laptop mockup is shown in the reference pages (Image 4), but the generated page (Image 1) lacks a device/product mockup entirely.

N07.rationale: The imagery appears specific to a real business context (consulting case study) rather than generic stock photography.

N08.rationale: There is no sparse dead whitespace; the layout is tightly packed with content in both columns.

N10.rationale: The large '01' numeral sits directly on top of the dark blue background without a scrim or inset gap to separate it from the text below.
